text:
mia: Quick sync — customers asking for a light "Inference Advisor" that recommends batching/caching/quant profiles and fires eval-triggered alerts. Need a tight pilot scope.
aj: +1. Are we aiming for suggestions-only or auto-apply in pilot?
mia: Suggestions-only for pilot. We want to validate econ + quality before any auto changes. Pilot groups: AcmeShop, DataLoop and FinX.
rex: For infra impact, suggest two phases: 1) offline analyzer that consumes traces and proposes configs, 2) live advisor that suggests per-route settings. Phase 1 is low risk.
lena: customers care about rollout gating. They want canary and rollback hooks in console, also per-tenant overrides.
samir: major risk is quantization regressions. We need eval gates: automated samplers + human review if delta > threshold.
aj: can we define concrete launch/pass criteria? even rough numbers help planning.
mia: draft criteria:
```
- Pilot readiness: 3 customers enrolled
- Perf: <= +10% median token latency for recommended configs
- Cost: >= 8% cost reduction on targeted workloads
- Quality: automated eval delta <= 1.5% (task-specific metric) OR manual sign-off
- Observability: per-route recommendation history + rollback button
- Safety: no auto-apply without explicit tenant opt-in
```
rex: + note: batching modifications must expose predicted p95 impact and an estimated batching gain.
lena: alerts: eval-triggered alert types: regression, drift, stale-cache-hit-rate drop. Each alert must include sample prompts and diffed outputs.
samir: for quant recommendations, surface model+quant config + expected tradeoffs and a small A/B harness link.
deploy-bot: Deploy status: infra prototype deployed to dev cluster (cluster-dev-3) — logs at https://ci/reports/123
aj: timeline idea: 2-week discovery -> 4-week phase1 offline -> 6-week phase2 live suggestions -> pilot 4 weeks.
mia: ok let's align on MVP for Q2 scope: offline analyzer + UI for per-route suggestions + eval-alert plumbing. Defer auto-apply & rollback automation to Q3.
rex: engineering asks: need sample traces from customers (batch size distribution, seq lengths). @lena can you drive data collection?
lena: will collect samples from AcmeShop & DataLoop this week. putting a short intake form in #help.
aj: I'll sketch the API contract for recommendations by EOD Friday.
mia: thanks all — action items: aj API spec, lena sample collection, rex infra cost estimate, samir eval gating tests. Sync Friday 10am. :thumbsup:
